blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Philippine National Police (PNP) revoked the licenses for seven registered firearms owned by a vlogger following the circulation of a viral video showing him allegedly “indiscriminately” firing a gun. The video was uploaded on Nov. 14 but was taken down by the uploader the following day, by which time it had already gone viral. Authorities are now coordinating with the vlogger to arrange the surrender of the firearms involved.
